description:
In accordance with FAR 6.302-1(a)(2) Department of State, U.S. Consulate General in Guadalajara, intents to award a Sole Source, Firm-fixed price, Purchase Order to the company TYMETAL CORP for the acquisition of Security Gate Maintenance, which includes providing repair and maintenance services to the security gates of the US Consulate General.

This is not a request for competitive quotations. However, interested parties may submit their capabilities and qualifications for future requirements in writing to the email address: GDLGSOProcurement@state.gov
